_meta.description: Recipe id -> the item template that recipe produces, and its crafting station.
_meta.authoritative: APK gameplaymetadata, via reference/game-defs/recipe_crafting_types.json in the capture repo. Not inferred, not mined from traffic.
_meta.why: The client sends a recipeId the server could not resolve for most crafts: recipes.json captured 34 and smith_craftables a handful. Everything else fell into a fallback that granted an item whose id was the RECIPE's id -- not a real template -- which broke five characters' saves and stopped two players loading the game at all (#176, #179, #180). That fallback now refuses the craft; this table is what lets it succeed instead.
_meta.identityCheck: every outputItemTemplateId here is a real entry in items.json -- 898 of 898, checked at build time and asserted by the consumer's tests. A recipe whose output is not a real template would recreate the original bug.
_meta.recipesWithoutAnOutput: Repairing, Tempering, Salvaging and Enchanting MODIFY an existing item and so declare no output; they are handled by item_mod_recipes.json and are deliberately absent here.
